title.narrative: Number of WSS Utilities/Municipalities undertaking community outreach and WASH IEC and behavior change communication (BCC) campaigns with households of Roma minorities and other vulnerable groups
Minimum number of new functional connections providing safe and reliable water services in vulnerable households
People provided with access to improved water sources
Improved continuity of water supply services (number of urban areas with minimum 18 hours of water supply)
Share of newly created and existing management positions filled by women through internal promotion or external recruitment among utilities participating in the Program
Improved financial viability of the WSS sector (as reflected in National Aggregated Score for Direct Operating Cost Coverage)
At least 1 WSS Utility aggregation process supported under the Program
Percentage of WSS Utilities receiving investment allocation based on eligibility and performance
Percentage of WSS Utilities submitting Business Plans to ERRU for approval
Number of energy efficiency audits undertaken in WSS Utilities
Number of WSS utilities/municipalities from within the 10 largest energy consumers with at least 20% energy savings in their operation of the services
Percentage of WSS utilities with agreed operational staff certified as per regulations on certification
New Business Plan guideline for tariff reviews approved by ERRU
Guidelines for on-site sanitation issued by AKUM
Improved sector financing instruments and incentives for improved performance adopted
New Performance Monitoring/Benchmarking system established and operationalized (and annual report with key KPIs in public domain)
Utility Corporate Governance and Citizen Engagement requirements approved (PAP measure)
Percentage of Utilities meeting at least 75 percent of their targets in Performance Agreements
